home.tagline: I'm a dev. Actually, more of an experimenter.

home.explore: What have I been up to?
home.flutter: I'm also getting into mobile apps and looking for fresh ideas to build.

university.title: University
university.preview: The very first lines of code.
university.memory: The first time a tiny project finally worked, I couldn't stop clicking through it. That little win made the next experiment feel possible.
university.story: A small class assignment turned into late-night experiments. I started connecting what I learned in lectures with little tools I could actually use.
highlights: Built a simple web app with classmates.
Practiced debugging, Git, and sharing code.
Discovered that making things was the best way to learn.
university.takeaway: Start small, ask questions, and keep experimenting.

career.title: First Job / Present
career.shortDescription: From my first job to everyday building and learning.
career.description: Turning ideas into real-world applications, while building, learning, and exploring new technologies.
career.preview: From my first job to the work I do today.
career.memory: A teammate's small suggestion during a code review solved a problem I'd been staring at all afternoon. Building together changed how I learned.
career.story: My first job became a place to keep growing. The same journey now includes taking ideas from a sketch to a working application and improving them with a team.
highlights: Built interfaces and connected them to application services.
Learned through code reviews, releases, and user feedback.
Kept exploring mobile apps, hardware, and side projects.
career.takeaway: Good software grows through collaboration and steady improvements.

future.title: What comes next?
future.shortDescription: Still curious about the next adventure.
future.description: No idea what the next sign will say. I bet there are plenty of fun things left to try.
future.preview: The road goes on… what will the next stop be?
future.tag: Next stop / Still a question mark
future.memory: This page is saved for a memory I haven't made yet. Maybe the next scribbled idea will turn into something worth sharing.
future.story: Maybe a new app, a homemade gadget, or something I haven't even imagined yet. I'm curious where this road will lead, so let's keep going and find out.
highlights: Prototype a small app that solves an everyday problem.
Combine a connected device with a custom printed enclosure.
Share an experiment and learn from the people who try it.
future.takeaway: Stay curious. Pick one idea and turn it into the next adventure.
